sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f128795a9c9243697.title: MicroLink Yaht
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f128795a9c9243697.description:
Yaht is a computerized version of the classic dice game that Milton Bradley has popularized as Yahtzee. Players roll five dice trying to get certain combinations for their scorecard. Players may reroll any of the five dice twice after the first roll. (They may also choose to stop rolling at any point before that.) Deciding where to put a score can be just as important as actually rolling a certain combination. If a player rolls particularly well, he can get bonus points.

The game was designed for PC/XT/AT computers with any kind of monitor. The graphics are made up of "ANSI characters," which allow for a more colorful display than CGA would have. Simple sound is provided by the PC speaker.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1431c90e38a095cb.title: Solo
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1431c90e38a095cb.description: You're Carlitos, the usual school boy who still has to hear the recommendations of his mother. Everything was going fine until someday you left your home and found a deserted street, but almost instantly you heard the sound of a grenade exploding, and some bad guys with a shotgun. You think of it as a nightmare, but then a bullet almost hits you. Just then you find a pistol in your bag, if these dudes are real, why shouldn't it be real too?Solo is another of the Opera games designed to be used with the Gun Stick, quite similar on its development to Opera's Trigger. Also, in spite of this game's solitary name, there will be the option to play a 2 players cooperative mode.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f11b056a405455d40.title: Goferpop
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f11b056a405455d40.description: Goferpop is a 2D 50K shooting game in which the player shoots gophers that pop out of the ground. The game field is a row of grass and the gophers will pop out anywhere on the field. The mouse is used to move a gun back and forth and when a gopher appears the player must click the mouse in order to shoot it. The score is based on how many gophers are killed and how quickly, as measured by the "Gophers shot per hour" metric. There is no game over, but there is a high score table.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1055e20b3cfb833e.title: Circlink
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1055e20b3cfb833e.description:
Circlink is a shareware strategy game for up to four players, the computer can take one of the available player positions if required.
The game is played on a 10x7 grid. In each cell is a circle with a hole in one side. The object of the game is to place a marble into a cell at the top of the grid and, by rotating either all cells in a column or all cells in a row, to move it to the bottom of the grid.
The game is customisable and is completed when one player moves one, two, three or four marbles to the bottom row.

The game has basic sound effects, mainly bleeps, and is entirely keyboard controlled

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f16528c4731ec88a9.title: DC-10
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f16528c4731ec88a9.description: A very early text based flight simulator. Unfortunately, it seems very difficult to play as there is currently no known scanned manual.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1fb3519c7c19be88.title: Perico Delgado Maillot Amarillo
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1fb3519c7c19be88.description:
"Perico Delgado Maillot Amarillo", a game based on the Spanish champion, was one of the first cycling simulators that reproduced accurately the ups and downs of one of the hardest sports. Here you can run in a singular test (after seeing the informative track profile), divided each one in four parts completely different and in which your reflections will be continuously put on approval.

Try to start the race in first position and obtain a perfect rate in your pedaling, at the same way you avoid the dangerous fans in smooth land; run in the hardest of the mountain ports in continuous struggle against the chronometer; descend at full speed through a street flooded of curves and finally arrive to the exciting final sprint, showing that you are worthy to take the yellow jersey.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1e993574c95b69bb.title: Flipperi - F Huuli Peri
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1e993574c95b69bb.description:
An absolutely horrible pinball game. The ball meerly floats over the board with physics that make no sense. Hit the flipper will strike the ball and move it no matter where it is on the board.

One of the worst games I have ever played in eXoDOS.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1c401318c1a3132b.title: Bouncy Bee Learns Words
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1c401318c1a3132b.description: It's that bee again. But this time he is combining his letters into words. Good for him.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f11968ede35b88618.title: Merchant Colony
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f11968ede35b88618.description:
Merchant Colony is more ambitious in scope than its title suggests. You are charged with the development of not just one colony, but an entire colonial empire during the Age of Exploration.

Actually, you're also a merchant prince as well...so you must not only found colonies, but build ships, load them with trade goods and commodities, and do everything you can to turn a profit through the exchange of goods at ports across the globe. Other nations (under control of the AI) will try to compete with you, and perhaps even make war on you.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1af76c977a2ba8ee.title: The Big Three
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1af76c977a2ba8ee.description:
The Big Three is a detailed World War II strategy game, named after the collective term for the leaders of the three superpowers of the time, Joseph Stalin, Franklin D. Roosevelt, and Winston Churchill, who united to oppose the Axis forces under Adolf Hitler.

The game is played with the keyboard, mouse or joystick. It is based on the traditional war game hexagonal grid system. Army, air-force and naval units are represented. Units such as tanks, ships, bombers etc. must be built before they can be deployed, supply chains must be secured and so on.

The shareware version contains three scenarios:

* Scenario 1 - No More Phoney War (Western Front 1940)

* Scenario 2 - After The 1st Thaw (Eastern Front 1942-44)

* Scenario 3 - Afrika Korps (Mediterranean Front 1940-42)

Four further scenarios, Russian Steppes, D-Day, Fall of the Reich, and Total War were provided in the full registered version.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1afa28df85e05719.title: Dark Ages
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1afa28df85e05719.description: You are the prince and heir to the land's greatest kingdom.  Garth, a wizard of immense power and greed, banished you as a child to far away while he ran the kingdom with an iron hand.As you grew, you were taught the ways of a master fighter.  And you learned well.  Return to your kindgom to end Garth's rule!

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1f10df8dee823ba3.title: Klondike
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1f10df8dee823ba3.description: Klondike is a single-player, shareware version of the classic solitaire game. The game can be played in 'Strict Mode' in which the player has just one pass through the stack of undealt cards, or 'Relaxed Mode' in which the player can go through the undealt cards multiple times. There is no 'drag and drop' mechanism for moving cards in this game, the player clicks on the card(s) to be moved and then clicks on their destination. There is in-game help text, comprehensive game documentation. The game is intended to be played with the mouse but can be played with a keyboard.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1e2fadabeb0e6519.title: Lexi-Cross
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1e2fadabeb0e6519.description:
Lexi-Cross is a fun TV game show based on elements from Wheel of Fortune and Scrabble in a humorous futuristic setting. Competing either against other living creatures (humans, aliens) or against robots, you must flip the tiles and use the revealed letters to form the correct words.

With more than 600 challenging puzzles, Lexi-Cross should keep the average game show fan busy for quite a while.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f147fb22ecf36cefa.title: M1 Tank Platoon
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f147fb22ecf36cefa.description: A very encompassing game that allowed players to issue orders to Tanks, AA units, Aircraft, Artillery and Infantry in a campaign against Warsaw Pact units in Europe, while specifically controlling a platoon of 4 M1 tanks. The player could jump into the position of the driver, gunner or commander of any of the tanks to view the world from a 1st person perspective, or work from a tactical map to command all his forces. Characters in the M1 platoon actually increased in skill as they survived battles.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f14a67c804e133950.title: Pro Team Soccer
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f14a67c804e133950.description: Drive! Shoot! Score! Never so much realism (claims the games box). Honestly, it is shovelware though.  The description states, "You choose your team and player formations, then square off against the computer for some world-class, hard driving soccer action!".  How innovative.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1f2dee42166a2758.title: Wissoll Circus Trophy
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1f2dee42166a2758.description: Wissoll was formerly a well-known manufacturer of chocolate and other confectionery products. This is a sweet jump and run game, one of the lesser known advergames of the Art Department, already described as historic. Interesting is the gameplay of the game. Your task is not just stubbornness to run from A to B, but also to maneuver your car through the whole course. This gives the game a lot of puzzle elements and sets it apart from other platforming games. The graphics are quite good, but the music is annoying after a short time.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f186bbcbd3510959a.title: Karzel
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f186bbcbd3510959a.description: Karzel is a side-scrolling arcade game with simple control options. The main task of the player is to overcome ten levels to reach the rainbow arc. The hero of the game, the legendary dwarf, is armed with two weapons, giving a momentary immortality diamonds and exceptional agility. On his way the dwarf encounters many surprises that are hidden by question marks. The surprise is revealed by throwing a rock at them. Besides the hostile creatures on the way the dwarf encounters numerous obstacles. In an extremely difficult situation, you can use the diamonds and ensure your immortality.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1fa7b4ec3ce24329.title: Mercenary Sniper
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1fa7b4ec3ce24329.description:
A Finnish free virtual shooting range, focused primarily on serious players in the sense that there will be no bloody meat grinder here, but there will be ammunition management and many subtleties associated with it. And the complexity will not allow to carry out perky shooting at everything that moves.

The whole plot consists in the fact that we play as a hired sniper who must kill all enemy soldiers. The game has ten levels that take place in different areas, and some even at night. At levels, in addition to the usual enemy military, there can be columns of cars, pillboxes, prisoners (who cannot be killed) and much more.

Unlike the vast majority of games, where each new level begins with a full scale of health, in Mercenary Sniperthere is no such luxury. To be cured, you need to visit the hospital and pay money. The cartridges are not endless, moreover, they also have to be bought in the store. Other weapons can also be purchased there. However, before that you have to sell the old one - you cannot wear more than one.

Finally, a large number of different items are available for sale: four types of scopes, bipods and tripods that reduce recoil, night vision goggles (for night missions), body armor and even silencers. All this not only directly affects the gameplay, but sometimes it is simply necessary.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1476f5963d684241.title: Teenagent
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1476f5963d684241.description:
You take the role of Mark Hopper, an ordinary teenager who gets hired by the RGB intelligence (he was selected by a fortune teller) to solve the mystery of gold disappearing from the Mega Bank. But first you're sent to the RGB training camp where you'll have to pass the three trials!

Teenagent is a humorous point-and-click adventure, originally available as shareware, but the DOS version was later re-released as freeware. You control Mark Hopper with a mouse - click on where you want him to go, left-click on objects and people to look at them, and right-click on them to interact with them. By moving the cursor to the top of the screen, you bring up your inventory.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1fcf115df775000a.title: Pulsar Flux
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1fcf115df775000a.description: A platformer where the action takes place in a distant and bleak future. Our hero is a small round fighting robot whose task is to destroy a sinister corporation, located on a remote planet and making a terrible drug there.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1e0aec904717e610.title: Janggun
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1e0aec904717e610.description:
Robots that carry the names of historic Korean generals are the heroes of this SRPG, so it doesn't surprise that the title of the game translates to generals. The enemies -of course- have Japanese names. Although the units are designed like mechas, they are not presented as manned but rather having a life on their own.

The game starts in simulation mode, where robots can be modified and resources invested into new body parts for them. After a rather lengthy briefing the actual mission starts, which takes the form of a rather dull and boring tactical battle. Somehow this part of the game doesn't transport the feeling one has much control over the outcome of the battle, but maybe the mechanics just very complicated.

The overview map screen looks very functional without any unnecessary embellishment, but the robots in their attack animations attest competent pixel art craft. Too bad that it should remain rarely employed, as for most of their future games, FEW shifted to cheap prerendered graphics.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1ce204b897f33d74.title: D!Zone
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1ce204b897f33d74.description: This is a large collection of over 900 levels for DOOM and 	DOOM II: Hell on Earth. Also included are a number of utilities, such as Windows conversions to add DOOM graphics to Windows, and a DOOM WAD Installation shell called D!.These levels were gathered from many level designers, they were not written by Wizardworks. Wizardworks gathered the levels and released them all on one CD.A full version of DOOM V. 1.666 or DOOM II is required to run these levels.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1db34ca80761ca10.title: Strip Poker Professional
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1db34ca80761ca10.description: The 4th edition of Strip Poker is done in SVGA but with the same girls from Strip Poker III. Now you can play with three girls at once. Rules of five cards poker are not changed. Big photos of the girls are lightly detailed than in previous edition. In game you have to undress the girl by taking all her money. Girl strips five times to loose the game.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f197314e492f93fb8.title: Hariboy's Quest
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f197314e492f93fb8.description:
Designed primarily for kids, Hariboy's Quest boasts attractive cartoon-style SVGA graphics and a fun cast of characters comprising all of Haribo's advertising mascots. The interface is very simple: left-click to look at or activate/interact with highlighted items, right-click to bring up the inventory (or interact with items in some
cases), and click both mouse buttons at once to bring up the save/load/options menu.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1fb1575959a5cceb.title: DREAMS to Reality
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f1fb1575959a5cceb.description: In this game you are Duncan - a man, who must save the worlds of Dream and Reality from dark force. World of dreams allows you, for example, to fly between islands in the sky or to make your clone. You will encounter some peaceful creatures, who can talk to you and help you with your quest, and evil ones, who want to take away your will and must be killed. So you jump and run your way through the ancient land in search for the well of mankind's dreams.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f14cb07d7a9ad71a4.title: Treasure Hunter
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:f14cb07d7a9ad71a4.description: In Treasure Hunter you play the nephew of Tuck Pinkleton, an old sailor and explorer who lives in the North American seaside village of Golden Greek. Your uncle has built a maritime museum with 5000 square meters of exhibit floor space, but there is no money left to fund the exhibits. He knows a solution though, as there are thousands of shipwrecks around the world filled with dazzling treasures. As he is too old, he asks you to search for these treasures, and he supplies you with his yacht, a computer with vidphone, and $30,000 to start. You first task is to find a crew and the necessary info for your first mission.
